name: Tomato Soup and Cheese Toastie
method: Pour the tomato soup into a small pan and heat gently for 5 minutes until steaming hot.
Butter the outside of the bread slices and fill with grated cheddar.
Toast the sandwich in a frying pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut in half and serve with the soup for dunking.
